title: Vercel UI SDK: Agent Bridge (snapshot/act/query), Retired-Ref Hysteresis, Guarded DOM Marks & WebMCP Tools
summary: The @ui-sdk/core page agent bridge shares an instance registry with observe, preserves component refs across unmount/remount cycles via a 500-entry retired FIFO queue, retains off-page snapshots for closed tabs, enforces data-agent-hidden / data-agent-secret / data-agent-confirm DOM marks (200-char prompt ceiling), and registers snapshot/act/query JSON Schemas into browser WebMCP (document.modelContext.registerTool) with mandatory allow gating.

references.description: ObservedChange, Entry WeakRef tracking, retired FIFO queue (retiredLimit = 500), and offPage snapshot retention
DOM safety marks: data-agent-confirm (200 char max), data-agent-hidden (isOffLimits), and data-agent-secret (isSecret)
AgentComponent, AgentStep, AgentAction types, mutating verb regex, and action synonym mappings
registerTools WebMCP integration with readOnlyHint/untrustedContentHint/consequentialHint and agentTools JSON Schema

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: UI agent bridges require WeakRef component registries with bounded retired-ref hysteresis, DOM-level confirm/hidden/secret boundary marks, and explicit allow gates for WebMCP tool registration.
